rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 209, ALSO KNOWN AS THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, ARTICLES 221 AND 236
rows.abstract: The bill provides for the liability of parents and guardians to be only subsidiary for injuries and damages caused by the acts or omissions of their children or wards between the ages of eighteen and twenty-one years provided that they continue to live with their parents or guardians.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-01-30

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING THE BANK DEPOSITS OF SENIOR CITIZENS FROM THE TWENTY PERCENT (20%) WITHHOLDING TAX ON INTEREST INCOME, AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7432
rows.abstract: The bill exempts senior citizens from paying the final 20% withholding tax on interest income from bank deposits to enable them to fully use their savings.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2008-01-30

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE CRIMINAL PENALTIES FOR UNAUTHORIZED PICTURES IN A MOTION PICTURE EXHIBITION FACILITY, AND CIVIL PENALTIES FOR UNAUTHORIZED PRERELEASE COPYRIGHTED WORKS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill provides penalties for the unauthorized recording of motion pictures in movie houses and other exhibition facilities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2008-01-30

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ASSURE MEANINGFUL DISCLOSURES OF THE TERMS OF RENTAL PURCHASE AGREEMENTS, INCLUDING DISCLOSURES OF ALL COSTS TO CONSUMERS UNDER SUCH AGREEMENTS AND TO PROVIDE CERTAIN SUBSTANTIVE RIGHTS TO CONSUMERS UNDER SUCH AGREEMENTS
rows.title_short: \"Consumer Disclosure and Rental Purchase Agreement Act\"
rows.abstract: The bill requires merchants to disclose to consumers the following terms and conditions of rental purchase agreements, among others:  a)  the amount of downpayment including fees, taxes and other charges; b) amount and timing of rental payments; and c) number and amount of rental payments necessary to acquire ownership of the property.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT since 2008-01-30

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO STRENGTHEN THE AUTHORITY OF THE DEPARTMENT OF TRADE AND INDUSTRY REGARDING FRAUD COMMITTED IN CONNECTION WITH SALES MADE WITH A TELEPHONE
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to provide consumers protection from deceptive marketing activities committed through telemarketing.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2008-01-30

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING GRANTS TO PUBLIC EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS IN ORDER TO ALLOW SUCH INSTITUTIONS TO PROMOTE CERTAIN EDUCATION INITIATIVES
rows.abstract: The bill awards grants to schools that promote the following:  a) charter education program; b) early reading program; c) safe and drug-free environment; d) standardized testing program; e) curriculum development panels; f) increased teaching standards program; and g) teaching excellence program.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-01-30

rows.abstract: The measure seeks the implementation of structural reforms in high school education.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-01-30

rows.abstract: The measure establishes a national center that shall maintain a database on all family resource and support programs, and develop and sponsor training for family resource and support program staff, among others.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on POPULATION AND FAMILY RELATIONS since 2008-01-30

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A STATUTE OF REPOSE FOR DURABLE GOODS USED IN A TRADE OR BUSINESS
rows.title_short: \"Workplace Goods Job Growth and Competitiveness Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: The bill prohibits the filing of a civil action against a manufacturer or seller of a durable good (goods or components thereof that has a normal life expectancy of three (3) years or more and is used in trade or business) for damage to property or for death or personal injury arising out of an accident if the accident occurs more than 18 years after the date of delivery of the durable good.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MANDATORY PREGNANCY TESTING OF ALL WOMEN OF CHILDBEARING AGE WHO WILL UNDERGO COSMETIC PROCEDURES THAT ARE HARMFUL TO PREGNANT WOMEN AND UNBORN CHILDREN, AND DISCLOSURE OF THE POTENTIAL RISKS OF SUCH PROCEDURES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill requires all cosmetic providers to conduct a pregnancy test on every female patient of child-bearing age.  It also obliges cosmetic providers to make a reasonable disclosure of available choices with respect to cosmetic procedures and the potential risks associated with them.

rows.abstract: The bill proposes the following amendments:  a)inclusion of representatives from the Departments of Tourism and Foreign Affairs in the Civil Aeronautics Board; b) creation of the office of the Executive Director; c) increase of penalties for violation of the R.A. 776; and d) imposition of policy guidlelines and directions for the Board to observe  in the exercise of its regulatory functions.

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-02-04

rows.abstract: The bill provides for the blacklisting of contractors, subcontractors, materialmen and suppliers who fail to use Philippine made products, materials and supplies in any public building or public work.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2008-02-04

rows.title_short: \"The Compliance to the Writ of Habeas Corpus Act of 2007\"
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to punish disobedience to the writ under the following instances:  a) a person who refuses or neglects to obey the writ; b) a member of the court who knowingly recommits to prison a person already discharged; c) a clerk of court who refuses without reason to issue a writ; and d) a person who intently transfers residence or transfers a person under his custody of restraint to elude the service of the writ.
